card.name: Every/Each starting a new sentence
card.fires_on: The words Every, Each, Everyone or Everything when they begin a new sentence or phrase, often right after a heading or with no punctuation break. Also seen in dosing lines such as 'Every 8 hours'.

modes.label: Sentence-opening Each/Every
modes.description: Each or Every begins a new sentence, often straight after a heading or the end of the previous sentence.
modes.example: Electricity can kill! <<Each>> year about 1000 accidents

modes.label: Every in dosing intervals
modes.description: Every starts a frequency phrase after a drug or regimen name.
modes.example: Monotherapy<< Every>> two months for up to two years

modes.label: Every in titles and slogans
modes.description: Every begins a campaign name or slogan.
modes.example: Help<< Every>> Mother Counts reduce needless maternal deaths

card.writes: It favors words like 'except' and 'else' and suppresses 'each' and 'all', so it pushes toward the rest of an 'every ...' phrase.
card.plain: It fires on the word Every or Each when it opens a sentence or phrase, including 'every 8 hours' in dosing.
